sample_outreach_messages.message: Hi Alice, thanks for the demo request from CloudScale AI. We can walk through how LeadFlow helps organize lead qualification and follow-up and discuss its relevance to your SaaS team. Would a 15-minute conversation be useful?

rubric.description: Demonstration ICP: lead-workflow SaaS for 11?500 employee technology and professional-service businesses. Industry is a proxy, not proof of use case. Weights are policy hypotheses, not learned probabilities.
policy_notes: All four factors must be observed for automatic decisions; unknown factors use [1,10] bounds and force review.
Qualification additionally requires company-size and industry scores >=6. No hard disqualifiers are assumed.
Missing contact/company blocks outreach, not the independently calculated fit decision.
Recency is measured against the explicit --as-of snapshot.
